record.question: It eliminates the need to track down a patient previous paper/medical records and assist in ensuring data accurate and legible.
record.explanation: Answer B: Electric Health Record. An electronic health record maintains longitudinal patient information and can improve legibility and access across encounters, reducing reliance on prior paper records. Reference: https://www.healthit.gov/faq/what-electronic-health-record-ehr. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
